title: A currency used by records can be deleted
label: BUG

panels.caption: Zoho: warning before the first extra currency

rows: "The added currency can only be deactivated and cannot be deleted." Zoho has no delete action.
DELETE /currencies/{USD} returns 204 while a deal is saved in USD, with no warning.
Keep a valid currency (a deactivated currency stays on old records).
The deal still says USD at rate 50, but USD no longer exists in the currency list.
